title: Contact Centre Personas — Discovery
subtitle: Illustrative personas for a utilities Service Cloud programme; validate in workshops

rows.label: Goals
cells: Resolve on first contact
Fix the fault in one visit
Hit SLA and CSAT targets
Get the supply restored fast

rows.label: Pains
cells: Five screens per call; no single customer view
Arrives without parts or job history
Reports built by hand in Excel
Repeats the story at every contact

rows.label: Key tasks
cells: Identify caller, log case, find answer, escalate
Accept job, travel, diagnose, record work
Monitor queues, coach, approve exceptions
Report outage, track status, rebook visit

rows.label: Channels and devices
cells: Desktop softphone, Service Console
Tablet and phone, often offline
Desktop, Omni-Channel supervisor
WhatsApp, web chat, phone, portal

rows.label: Salesforce must
cells: Service Console with Customer 360 panel and Knowledge
Field Service mobile app with offline sync
Omni-Channel supervisor and service analytics
Experience Cloud portal and Agentforce agent
